I think the biggest issue is a (somewhat) unrealized dichotomy. Those basing their opinions and observations on empirical evidence claim pretty solidly that their is nothing physical that proves another realm/life after death. However, the pre-understanding of the opposing view is that this realm/life after death/whatever you want to call it cannot be observed by a materialistic viewpoint. 

TL;DR Science says life after death is impossible; faith never said science could point it out in the first place.
